instruction:
Begin in SolidWorks with C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_030_split_multibody.step. Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut). For this task, run the SOLIDWORKS automation through `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe` when working on `cli_030_split_multibody.step`.

Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file containing five separated unnamed bodies representing base, left_cover, right_cover, pin, and washer. Identify them by geometry and position: base is a 70 x 45 x 12 mm block at X=0, the covers are 40 x 25 x 8 mm blocks at X=75 and X=120, the pin is an 8 mm diameter x 40 mm long vertical cylinder at X=165, and the washer is an OD18/ID8 x 4 mm vertical washer at X=178. Export each body separately as C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_030_base.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_030_left_cover.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_030_right_cover.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_030_pin.step, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_030_washer.step using local coordinates centered on that body. Also export the unchanged full assembly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_030_full_assembly_out.step. Do not change any size or assembly position.
